caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jug positioned upright on a neutral, light beige background. The jug has an overall buff or light tan color, a rounded, bulbous body, a narrow neck, and a small circular mouth at the top. Attached to the neck is a single curved handle that connects just below the mouth and extends to the upper shoulder of the jug. The front of the jug features decorative motifs in dark blue, including a large stylized flower with eight petals and dot accents, as well as four elongated, pointed leaves arranged symmetrically beneath the flower. Above the floral design, there is a line of text in blue, reading "RICHARD ALBERTSON." The jug appears smooth with some subtle shading and faint irregularities indicating texture and natural wear. The entire composition is centered, with no additional objects present, and there is a faint rectangular border in a slightly darker tone framing the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
